g.text: vco-discrete: summer U1A -> 17.9 mV/V divider (SCALE) -> NPN pair pair, servo U1B holds 21 uA -> integrator U2A + 2.2 nF C0G

g.desc: vco-discrete: summer U1A -> 17.9 mV/V divider (SCALE) -> NPN pair pair, servo U1B holds 21 uA -> integrator U2A + 2.2 nF C0G

g.text: Reset: comparator at 5 V (the +5 V reference) drives the N-FET; Q3 + R30 drop the threshold to ~0.2 V until the reset is complete. f = I / (2.2 nF x 5 V). Coarse centre ~82 Hz, +/-5 oct.

g.desc: Reset: comparator at 5 V (the +5 V reference) drives the N-FET; Q3 + R30 drop the threshold to ~0.2 V until the reset is complete. f = I / (2.2 nF x 5 V). Coarse centre ~82 Hz, +/-5 oct.

g.text: Calibrate: SCALE (RV1) for octaves, HF TRIM (RV2) for the top octaves, COARSE for pitch. R11 can be a 2k 3300 ppm/K tempco. Outputs +/-5 V through 1k.

g.desc: Calibrate: SCALE (RV1) for octaves, HF TRIM (RV2) for the top octaves, COARSE for pitch. R11 can be a 2k 3300 ppm/K tempco. Outputs +/-5 V through 1k.

g.text: SYNC: a rising edge resets the core through Q3 (hard sync). PWM: the PW pot sets the width unpatched, the PWM depth patched (normal = +5 V).

g.desc: SYNC: a rising edge resets the core through Q3 (hard sync). PWM: the PW pot sets the width unpatched, the PWM depth patched (normal = +5 V).
